Upload all required documents at the time of application, including educational mark sheets, and photo, signature, income, caste, and residence proofs, as applicable. Widowed, divorced, or separated candidates must also upload their supporting proof within the same window.

content_sections.text: The 172 Anganwadi Karyakatri vacancies are distributed across 13 Bal Vikas Pariyojnas (Child Development Projects) in Amethi district, with category-wise reservation as shown below. The notification adds that the number of vacancies published may change due to special circumstances. Any discrepancy relating to vacancies or reservation will be resolved by the selection committee before further action, and its decision will be final.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The eligibility conditions for UP Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026, as specified in the official notification, are as follows. Only female candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised Anganwadi Karyakatri posts. The applicant must be a permanent resident of the ward or gram sabha to which the vacant post belongs. A residence certificate issued by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), which can be verified online, is mandatory. For urban areas, the ward number must be mentioned on the residence certificate. Widowed candidates must submit a death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned Nagar Nikay, along with a certified copy of the family register. Divorced or separated candidates must submit a valid order from a competent court. Candidates claiming reservation under the poverty line (BPL) category must submit an income certificate issued by the concerned Tehsildar that can be verified online. As per a 2015 Government Order (as amended), the annual income limit is Rs 46,080 for rural areas and Rs 56,460 for urban areas. Income, residence, and caste certificates will be valid only if issued in the name of the applicant concerned. An income certificate is valid only if issued within 3 years prior to the date of publication of this notification. A BPL-category income certificate issued more than 3 years earlier will be treated as valid only under the APL category. The article does not state that all applicants meeting general criteria are automatically eligible; residence, category, and certificate conditions above are specific and must each be satisfied. The minimum educational qualification for the Anganwadi Karyakatri post is Intermediate (12th) or an equivalent qualification. Merit will be prepared based on marks scored from Intermediate up to Postgraduate level, wherever a candidate holds a higher qualification. The merit/weightage formula given in the notification works as follows: the percentage of marks obtained in Intermediate (marks obtained divided by full marks) is itself divided by 10 to arrive at a score. For example, if the full marks are 500 and a candidate scores 300, that is 60%; dividing 60 by 10 gives a weightage of 6 marks for Intermediate. The same method is applied separately for Graduate and Postgraduate marks (where applicable), and the scores from Intermediate, Graduate, and Postgraduate are added together to form the final merit/weightage. As on 1 July 2026, the applicant's age must not be less than 18 years and not more than 35 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for UP Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026 will be made through a merit list prepared using the academic marks-based formula described above (Intermediate up to Postgraduate), combined with verification of residence, age, category, and other eligibility documents. The notification does not mention any separate written examination or interview as part of the selection process. Eligibility, qualification, and merit determination will follow the Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687), dated 17 September 2025.

Widowed, divorced, or separated candidates must also upload their supporting proof within the same window. Carefully verify all educational marks and percentage details entered before final submission, since incomplete, incorrect, or falsified entries will lead to rejection of the application, and no offline correction will be accepted afterward. Submit the form before the deadline of 21 September 2026 (till midnight, 12:00 AM). Applications for UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 must be submitted only through the official website, upanganwadibharti.in. faq.question: Q1. What is UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Office of the District Programme Officer, Amethi, to fill 172 Anganwadi Karyakatri posts on an honorarium/contract basis across 13 projects in Amethi district, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 172 vacancies are available for the Anganwadi Karyakatri post, distributed across 13 Bal Vikas Pariyojnas in Amethi district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 21 September 2026, till midnight 12:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th) or equivalent. Merit is calculated using marks from Intermediate up to Postgraduate, where applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 1 July 2026, as recorded in their High School certificate.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only through the official website, upanganwadibharti.in, between 1 September 2026 and 21 September 2026. Offline applications are not accepted.
